tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List services currently available from the Atinamos Agent Shop.

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Get the machine-readable definition of one live Agent Shop service by catalogue slug.

tools.name: invoke_service
tools.description: Prepare a paid invocation of one live Agent Shop service. Returns the exact x402 HTTP request and price; it does not execute the service or bypass payment.

tools.name: market_search
tools.description: Search machine services observed by Atinamos harvesters across external discovery sources. Results are observational evidence, not an endorsement, trust score or guarantee of current availability.

tools.name: market_service
tools.description: Get one observed machine service from the live Atinamos market registry by its canonical Atinamos service ID.
